title: One invoice application notified through RabbitMQ
status: Implemented and validated in the single-VM lab

scope.other_consumers: Continue direct SeaweedFS/PostgreSQL reads; order exports are not routed to RabbitMQ
scope.notification: Metadata pointer to a committed full-export publication; no invoice rows in AMQP

deployment.runtime: Persistent broker, polling dispatcher, invoice application; ten total permanent containers
deployment.management: 127.0.0.1:15672 through SSH/IAP; private AMQP network, additional broker-only management bridge

contract.identity: SHA-256 of canonical JSON of all notification fields except event_id
contract.discovery: Full-prefix rescan every 30 seconds; immutable per-key discovery record

publisher.state: Local SQLite outbox committed before send
publisher.send: Persistent message, publisher confirm and mandatory routing
publisher.recovery: Unconfirmed outbox rows are retried with the same identity; uncertain confirms can cause duplicate messages
publisher.meaning: Confirmed means broker accepted; it does not mean application committed

consumer.qos: Prefetch 1, single active consumer; background processing while AMQP thread services heartbeats
consumer.transaction: Validate every file and atomically replace invoice_lines, insert delivery history and update active pointer in one SQLite transaction; ACK afterward
consumer.duplicate: Matching committed event ID is acknowledged without applying again
consumer.ordering: UTC warehouse capture timestamp then run ID; older unseen runs are validated and recorded as superseded
consumer.deletions: Missing rows disappear on atomic full replacement; no incremental event/delete feed
consumer.money: Exact Decimal during validation; canonical decimal strings in application row JSON

local_storage.journal: DELETE rollback journal; synchronous=EXTRA; persistent disk; one writer per state directory
local_storage.reason: Single-writer lab application; no additional DB server. Avoid WAL-reset race documented for SQLite 3.40.1 supplied by the base image.
local_storage.recovery: Rollback on incomplete transaction; committed local inbox and business rows survive process/container recreation
local_storage.limits: Not distributed state, not an HA or off-VM restore proof; live file copies are not a backup procedure

topology.queue_type: quorum with one member in this lab
topology.retries: Five-second application delay then basic.reject(requeue=True); basic.nack does not increment failed-delivery count in RabbitMQ >=4.3

security.publisher: Publish to exports.ready only; S3 list bucket/read invoice publication markers only
security.application: Consume invoice-app.ready only; S3 read invoice publication/data paths only
security.operator: Separate generated administrator account; salted hashes in broker definitions; no guest account
security.runtime: Non-root workers; no admin secrets, source/warehouse network or database credentials
security.boundaries: Trusted VM/Docker/filer admin surfaces; no TLS inside VM or hostile-tenant isolation claim

checks: Publisher crash before send and after confirm
Application crash during replacement and after commit before ACK
Atomic removal of absent full-snapshot rows
Corruption in a later file leaves old application data intact
Bounded retry and DLQ; mandatory unroutable publish
All stored real invoice rows match the accepted export
Fresh full export delivered automatically by watch services
Ten healthy services, unchanged warehouse CDC counts, cleanup disabled

rollback: Stop dispatcher and invoice-app, retain broker data/outbox/app state/secrets and last verified image. Direct consumers remain available. Do not reset offsets or erase queues to retry.
deferred: Airflow export scheduling and operational alerting
DLQ review and approved replay operations
Off-VM recovery, HA, retention and TLS
Safe CDC purge and source decommissioning
conventions: Notification schema, local outbox, ordering rule and deployment topology are project decisions, not a universal enterprise architecture.
